clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope— Requirements for precast reinforced concrete channel units having a length of up to 4.5 m used for construction of floors and roofs.

clauses.title: Shape, Dimension and Tolerance
clauses.text: 2. Shape, Dimension and Tolerance

clauses.title: Shape
clauses.text: 2.1 Shape

clauses.title: The precast units shall
clauses.text: 2.1.1 The precast units shall be channel (inverted trough) shapes, having outer sides corrugated and grooved at ends to provide shear key action transfer of moments between adjacent units. (Fig 1 and 2).

clauses.title: Inner sides of the
clauses.text: 2.1.2 Inner sides of the channel shall be kept sloping, as shown in Fig. 2 to simplify easy demoulding. The slope may be kept between 1/8 to 1/16.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 2.2 Dimensions

clauses.title: Length
clauses.text: 2.2.1 Length— The maximum length of the unit shall be restricted to 4.5 m from stiffness considerations.

clauses.title: Width
clauses.text: 2.2.2 Width— The nominal width of channel unit shall be 300 mm or 600 mm.

clauses.title: Depth
clauses.text: 2.2.3 Depth— The depth of the channel unit shall be kept either 130 mm or 200 mm.

clauses.title: Thickness of flange
clauses.text: 2.2.4 Thickness of flange— The minimum thickness of flange shall be 30 mm for 300 mm wide channel units and 35 mm for 600 mm wide channels.

clauses.title: Thickness of web (legs of channel unit)
clauses.text: 2.2.5 Thickness of web (legs of channel unit)— The minimum thickness of the channel leg shall be not less than 25 mm. SUMMARY OF IS  14201 : 1994 PRECAST REINFORCED CONCRETE CHANNEL UNITS FOR CONSTRUCTION OF FLOORS AND ROOFS

clauses.title: Tolerances on Dimensions
clauses.text: 2.3 Tolerances on Dimensions

clauses.title: Dimension
clauses.text: 2.3.1 Dimension Tolerance Length ± 5 mm Width ± 3 mm Bow (deviation from intended ± 3 mm line or plane) Twist (distance of any corner ± 3 mm from the plane containing other three corners) 2.3.1 Squareness— When considering the squareness of the corner, the longer of the two sides being checked shall be taken as the base line. The shorter length shall not vary in length from the perpendicular by more than 3 mm.

clauses.title: Flatness
clauses.text: 2.3.2 Flatness— The maximum deviation from a 1.5 m straight edge placed in any position on a nominal plane surface shall not exceed 2 mm.

clauses.title: Design
clauses.text: 3. Design

clauses.title: The channel units shall
clauses.text: 3.1 The channel units shall be designed in accordance with IS 14215:1994.*

clauses.title: Reinforcement
clauses.text: 3.2 Reinforcement * Code of practice for design and construction of floors and roofs with precast reinforced concrete channel units. Fig. 1  Channel Unit

clauses.title: Main reinforcement of the
clauses.text: 3.2.1 Main reinforcement of the channel units shall comprise two bars of required diameter as per the design placed at the bottom of two legs of channel unit. Two bars of mild steel Grade 1 conforming to IS 432 (Part 1): 1982,* 6 mm  shall be provided at top corners to support the stirrups (see Fig  2). Stirrups of 3 mm  at the rate of 300 mm c/c along the length of the channel unit (see Fig  2) shall be provided. Note 1—  For details of materials refer to 3 of the standard. Note 2—  For details of manufacture refer to 6 of the standard. Note 3—  For method of test refer to Annex A of the standard. For detailed information, refer to IS14201:1994 Specification for precast reinforced concrete channel units for construction of floors and  roofs. * Mild steel and medium tensile steel bars and hard-drawn steel wire for concrete reinforcement, Part 1 Mild steel and medium tensile steel bars (third revision).

clauses.title: Cover to reinforcement
clauses.text: 3.2.2 Cover to reinforcement — The minimum cover to reinforcement shall be 15 mm.

clauses.title: Tests
clauses.text: 4. Tests— Tests for dimensional conformity, deflection recovery and failure load shall be conducted. Fig. 2  Typical Details of Channel Unit
